676:t_5:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

676:t_5:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...So $$ガイゾック$$, which destroyed the $$ビアル星人$$, came to see humanity as the enemy because of the $$御使い$$s...」

676:t_5:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「They said that if humanity advances its civilization, that ends up calling the $$御使い$$s.」

676:t_5:6.en:
$$万丈$$
「By that logic, the $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ of $$ガイゾック$$ came to condemn humanity's very existence as the thing that summons them... in other words, as evil.」

676:t_5:7.en:
$$シン$$
「What kind of insane story is that...! Are you saying humanity has no right to live if the $$御使い$$s exist?!」

676:t_5:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「I thought Big Bro $$シン$$ was right too. That's why I fought them.」

676:t_5:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「But the existence of the $$御使い$$s seems to affect all sorts of worlds, even more than we imagined.」

676:t_5:10.en:
$$隼人$$
「It was them who labeled the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s as $$バアル$$, too.」

676:t_5:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The way you put it, it sounds as if they aren't really $$バアル$$ to begin with...」

676:t_5:12.en:
$$號$$
「One of the definitions of $$バアル$$ is being unable to communicate, but...」

676:t_5:13.en:
$$號$$
「At the very least, the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s that parasitized $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$ understand human speech.」

676:t_5:14.en:
$$刹那$$
「In other words, mutual understanding is possible.」

676:t_5:15.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That said, in reality, they're the kind who put their own evolution first and treat every other living thing as an enemy.」
